create_nuscenes_monocular_infos: create monocular and multi-view info pickle files for NuScenes train and val splits from a data root path
fill_trainval_infos: fill train and val monocular and multi-view info lists by iterating over NuScenes samples and computing camera calibrations
review_create_nuscenes_monocular_infos: review the create_nuscenes_monocular_infos function to understand how it filters scenes and dumps monocular and multi-view pickle files
refactor_fill_trainval_infos: refactor the _fill_trainval_infos function to support additional camera types beyond the default six NuScenes cameras
summarize_nuscenes_monocular_converter: summarize the nuscenes_monocular_converter module which converts NuScenes 3D bounding boxes to monocular depth format for camera-based detection
